tools.name: find_stations
tools.description: Find stations in Bizzy's full backend catalog by name or location, including unavailable stations. Empty query lists all. ID-sorted, bounded pagination; follow next_offset until null.

tools.name: get_station
tools.description: Get a Bizzy station by a real catalog UUID. Returns the listening page, not an audio stream. Does not start playback.

tools.name: get_bizzy_info
tools.description: Read the Bizzy authors and Misha Naer's public contact channels. No authentication required.
